grades.question: An Infection card has just been drawn and would cause an outbreak. Can Airlift move the Quarantine Specialist before that outbreak? When may it be played before the next card, who chooses its use, what action cost applies, and where is the played Event discarded?

grades.observed_answer: No. Airlift cannot be played between drawing an Infection card and resolving it, so it cannot move the Quarantine Specialist before that card’s outbreak resolves. An Event can be played at any time except between drawing and resolving a card; therefore it may be played after resolving the current card and before the next card. The player who plays it chooses its use. It costs no action, and played Event cards go to the Player Discard Pile.
grades.reader_evidence: Event Cards: any time (not an action), cannot be played between drawing and resolving a card, player decides use, discard to Player Discard Pile. Airlift moves any 1 pawn.
grades.reason: All requested facts match key; equivalent wording accepted.
